tools.description:
Copies a node in a line, around an axis or in a grid. Copies share its parent; offsets are in the parent's space. One undo step. Fails for groups (use scene.duplicate_node) or more than 1000 copies.
Returns: {created, ids} (ids of the copies, at most 100).

center.description: radial: centre (parent space, default the parent origin). ([x, y, z] (cm))

count.description: linear/radial: total items including the original (2-1001).

counts.description: grid: copies per axis [nx,ny,nz] including the original (default [2,2,1]). ([x, y, z] integers)

offset.description: linear: step [x,y,z] cm between copies (default [100,0,0]). ([x, y, z] (cm))

spacing.description: grid: spacing [x,y,z] cm (default: the bounds size). ([x, y, z] (cm))

target.description: Node to copy. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: build.array

returnValue.description: {created, ids} (ids of the copies, at most 100).

created.description: Copies created (the original is not counted).

ids.description: Node ids of the copies in creation order (at most 100).

returnValue.title: BuildToolCopiesResult

tools.description:
Cuts, joins or intersects two builder objects. The result is recorded in the target's recipe (rebuildable); the tool object is consumed unless keep_tool. Undoable. Fails if either is not a builder object or both are the same node.
Returns: {target, op, ops (operations on the target so far), triangles}.

keep_tool.description: Keep the tool object instead of deleting it.

target.description: Builder object to change. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tool.description: Builder object used as the cutter or addition (positioned where it should cut). (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: build.boolean_op

returnValue.description: {target, op, ops (operations on the target so far), triangles}.

ops.description: Boolean operations now recorded on the target.

returnValue.title: BuildToolBooleanResult

tools.description:
Renders one contact-sheet image (attached to the result) of orthographic front/right/top and perspective views framing the build, to check proportions. Fails without rendering (null RHI) or when there is nothing to frame.
Returns: {layout, bounds_size, w, h}; the image is attached.

targets.description: Frame these objects (default: every node, or `under`).

items.description: Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path

under.description: Frame this subtree. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

views.description: Views to render (default front, right, top, perspective).

tools.name: build.capture_view

returnValue.description: {layout, bounds_size, w, h}; the image is attached.

layout.description: Where each view is in the sheet, e.g. "front(row 0, col 0)".

returnValue.title: BuildToolCaptureResult

tools.description:
Finds node pairs whose bounds interpenetrate more than the tolerance (parents and their children are not compared). A bounding-box test: intended overlaps (booleans, touching parts) also appear.
Returns: {checked, overlaps, pairs:[{a, b, depth}], note}, pairs sorted by the first node's min X.

tolerance.description: Ignore overlaps up to this depth cm.

under.description: Only check below this node (default: every node). (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: build.check_overlaps

returnValue.description: {checked, overlaps, pairs:[{a, b, depth}], note}, pairs sorted by the first node's min X.

overlaps.description: Overlapping pairs found (pairs may be truncated to limit).

returnValue.title: BuildToolOverlapReport

tools.description:
Builds many parts (up to 512) as ONE object in one call: the fast way to make detailed buildings. Each part is a shape recipe plus location/rotation/scale and its own material fields; parts without material fields use the defaults given here. One undo step. Fails with the part index when a part is invalid.
Returns: {id, name, path, triangles, parts, materials, coplanar_faces_separated, snapped_to_ground}.

location.description: World location cm (relative to the parent when one is given). ([x, y, z] (cm))

material.description: Default preset for parts without one, e.g. "sandstone".

metallic.description: Default metallic (omit for the preset value).

parent.description: Parent group. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

parts.description: Part recipes. Each: {shape, size, <shape params>, location, rotation, scale, material, color, roughness, metallic, style, tile, relief, bevel}. Shapes: box sphere cylinder cone pyramid torus wedge capsule plane dome tube arch roof lattice steps tiers column openings, revolve{profile:[[r,z]..],segments,angle}, extrude{profile:[[x,y]..],height | profile:[[x,y,z]..],direction}, sweep{profile:[[x,y]..],path:[[x,y,z]..],closed}, loft{sections:[[[x,y,z]..]..],closed,cap}, raw{vertices,triangles}. Booleans per part: ops:[{op:subtract|union|intersect,tool:{recipe},location}]. E.g. [{"shape":"box","size":[400,400,40]},{"shape":"cylinder","size":[30,30,300],"location":[150,150,40],"material":"copper"}].

repair_coplanar.description: Nudge overlapping same-plane faces of later parts outward to stop flicker.

roughness.description: Default roughness (omit for the preset value).

snap_to_ground.description: Rest the bottom of the bounds on the ground below.

tools.name: build.create_assembly

returnValue.description: {id, name, path, triangles, parts, materials, coplanar_faces_separated, snapped_to_ground}.

coplanar_faces_separated.description: Same-plane overlapping faces nudged apart (repair_coplanar) so they do not flicker.

id.description: Node id of the assembly (one object for all parts).

materials.description: Material slots: one per distinct combination of material fields.

returnValue.title: BuildToolAssemblyResult

tools.description:
Creates a parametric mesh at true scale (cm). Base pivot by default, so the object sits on its location. Undoable. Fails if a material field is invalid (unknown preset or style) or the parent is not a scene node.
Returns: The new node: {id, name, path, triangles, snapped_to_ground}.

bevel.description: Chamfer hard edges by this many cm. Boxes, wedges and extrusions get a small automatic bevel at -1; 0 keeps edges sharp.

color.description: Base colour override [r,g,b] linear 0-1, e.g. [0.42,0.34,0.24]. ([x, y, z] (cm))

count.description: steps/tiers: number of steps or tiers (steps default 8, tiers 5).

location.description: [x,y,z] cm (relative to the parent when one is given). ([x, y, z] (cm))

margin.description: openings: border around the grid cm.

material.description: Preset (list_materials), e.g. "sandstone", or an allowed material path. Omit for white.

metallic.description: 0 dielectric .. 1 metal (omit for the preset value).

opening.description: openings: [width,height] cm of each opening, e.g. [120,220]. ([x, y])

parent.description: Parent node (group or object). (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

roughness.description: 0 mirror .. 1 matte (omit for the preset value).

size.description: [x,y,z] cm: box dims; round shapes use x as diameter and z as height; torus z = tube; arch/roof = width, depth, height. E.g. [400,300,250]. ([x, y, z] (cm))

snap_to_ground.description: Move the object down (or up) so the bottom of its bounds rests on what is below it.

style.description: Surface style override, e.g. "brick" (presets pick one; see list_materials).

taper.description: lattice/tiers: top size / bottom size (lattice default 1, tiers 0.4).

tile.description: Pattern size cm (brick length, block width, tile width).

tools.name: build.create_primitive

returnValue.description: The new node: {id, name, path, triangles, snapped_to_ground}.

id.description: Node id of the new object (pass it to other tools).

snapped_to_ground.description: True when snap_to_ground moved the object onto the ground below.

returnValue.title: BuildToolNodeResult

tools.description:
Creates a solid from a 2D profile: lathe (domes, columns, vases), extrude (walls, floor plans), sweep (rails, pipes). Undoable. Fails if the profile has too few points (lathe 2, extrude and sweep 3) or a sweep has no path.
Returns: The new node: {id, name, path, triangles, snapped_to_ground}.

bevel.description: Chamfer edges by this many cm. Extrusions get a small automatic bevel at -1; 0 keeps edges sharp.

closed.description: sweep: the path is a loop.

color.description: Base colour override [r,g,b] linear 0-1. ([x, y, z] (cm))

location.description: [x,y,z] cm (relative to the parent when one is given). ([x, y, z] (cm))

material.description: Preset (list_materials) or an allowed material path. Omit for white.

metallic.description: 0 dielectric .. 1 metal (omit for the preset value).

parent.description: Parent node. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

profile.description: 2D points [[x,y],...]: lathe = [radius,height] path, e.g. [[0,0],[40,0],[30,60],[0,90]]; extrude/sweep = closed polygon.

roughness.description: 0 mirror .. 1 matte (omit for the preset value).

snap_to_ground.description: Rest the bottom of the bounds on the ground below.

tools.name: build.create_profile_solid

returnValue.description: The new node: {id, name, path, triangles, snapped_to_ground}.

id.description: Node id of the new object (pass it to other tools).

snapped_to_ground.description: True when snap_to_ground moved the object onto the ground below.

returnValue.title: BuildToolNodeResult

tools.description: Counts nodes, triangles, components, materials and estimated draw calls (performance budget of a build).

under.description: Only count below this node (default: every node). (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: build.get_build_stats

tools.description: READ FIRST before building: quality bar, real-scale dimensions, part shapes, generators, materials and the build workflow for realistic results.
tools.name: build.get_guide

tools.description:
Lists the material presets, surface styles and part shapes the builder accepts.
Returns: {presets, styles, shapes}.
tools.name: build.list_materials

presets.description: Material presets for the `material` field, sorted as defined (stones, metals, glass, ground, plain colours).

shapes.description: Every part shape accepted by create_assembly.

styles.description: Procedural surface styles for the `style` field.

tools.description:
Measures distance, gap and sizes between two objects' bounds (children included).
Returns: {center_distance, center_delta, gap, gap_xyz, size_a, size_b, overlapping}.

a.description: First object. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

b.description: Second object. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: build.measure

returnValue.description: {center_distance, center_delta, gap, gap_xyz, size_a, size_b, overlapping}.

gap.description: Shortest distance between the bounds (0 when they touch or overlap).

returnValue.title: BuildToolMeasurement

tools.description:
Creates a mirrored copy of a node across a plane (parent space); the reflection is kept as a negative scale. Undoable. Fails for groups.
Returns: {created: 1, ids: [copy]}.

point.description: A point on the mirror plane [x,y,z] (default the parent origin). ([x, y, z] (cm))

target.description: Node to mirror. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: build.mirror

created.description: Copies created (the original is not counted).

ids.description: Node ids of the copies in creation order (at most 100).

tools.description:
Places a packaged static mesh asset (a real tree, rock or prop made in Blender) as a scene node. For many copies use pcg.scatter with asset items (GPU instances). Undoable. Fails if the asset is not a packaged static mesh.
Returns: {id, name, path, triangles}.

asset.description: Static mesh path, e.g. "/Game/RuntimeFoliage/Trees/SM_Oak_01" (level.find_assets with asset_class StaticMesh lists them).

location.description: World location cm (relative to the parent when one is given). ([x, y, z] (cm))

parent.description: Parent group. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: build.place_mesh

id.description: Node id of the new object (pass it to other tools).

snapped_to_ground.description: True when snap_to_ground moved the object onto the ground below.

tools.description:
Changes the material fields of builder objects (same fields as create tools); fields not given keep their value. One undo step. Fails if no field is given, a field is invalid, or none of the targets is a builder object.
Returns: {changed: [ids], skipped_not_builder: [refs]}.

material.description: Preset (list_materials) or an allowed material path, e.g. "copper". Setting it clears a previous colour override unless color is given.

items.description: Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path

tools.name: build.set_material

skipped_not_builder.description: Targets that are not builder objects (use the materials toolset for them).
